evidence: Static review plus a scripted parse of the frozen seed (python json with duplicate-key hook; no container, no app run). File inventory: the only shipped JSON/CSV/TSV data are environment/assets/seed_data.json and its byte-identical copy solution/app/src/seed_data.json (both sha256 1b39015461a7...), plus solution/app/package.json; no CSV/TSV exists. PARSE: valid JSON, no BOM, LF only, ASCII only, no duplicate keys, no floats; every money/unit value is a nonnegative integer except the signed seed_commitments movements, as hireops_rules.md:71-88 requires. UNIQUENESS: 7 users, 3 employees, 7 requisitions, 13 offers, all ids unique; emails and candidates unique. REFERENCES: every offers[].req_id resolves to a requisition; every referred_by resolves to an employee (EMP-R1/R2/R3) and is paired with a referred_hire_start; every raised_by/approved_by resolves to a user; every seed_commitments/seed_equity_grants/seed_remittances/seed_referral_accruals row resolves to an existing COMMITTED offer, and each commitment's req_id equals its offer's req_id. No orphan rows in either direction: all 8 COMMITTED offers have exactly one commitment; the only COMMITTED offer with equity (OFF-201) has exactly one grant with matching units/strike/fair and grant_date equal to its start_date (seed lines 425-432 vs 222-238); the two COMMITTED offers with a signing bonus (OFF-201 4000000, OFF-205 3000000) each have one SIGNING remittance of the same amount (lines 434-444); the two COMMITTED referred offers (OFF-110/EMP-R2, OFF-111/EMP-R3) each have one accrual whose referrer, candidate and referred_hire_start equal the offer's (lines 446-458). PENDING/DRAFT offers carry no commitment, grant, remittance, accrual or approver. ARITHMETIC against the public rules: every seed commitment equals minus the offer's committed run-rate as defined in hireops_rules.md:112-127, e.g. OFF-201 = 17000000 + round_half_up(7200*(2500-1000)/4)=2700000 -> -19700000 (seed line 402). Each approver's seeded tier covers the recomputed band (OFF-092 basis 21000000 Band II by USR-APP2 tier 2; OFF-291 basis exactly 20000000 = Band II under the half-open edge, by USR-APP3; OFF-201 basis 21700000 Band II by USR-APP3; the rest Band I by USR-APP2); no COMMITTED row is self-approved; no PENDING row is raised by the auditor (OFF-DC raised by approver USR-APP2 is permitted by hireops_rules.md:44). constants (lines 4-25) equal the prose: annualization 4 years, band floors $200,000/$350,000, signing 12mo/40%/+5%/24mo (40+12*5=100), equity 12mo/20%/+4%/32mo (20+20*4=100), referral $10,000, 50%, 6 months; reference_moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z equals hireops_rules.md:60 and tests/app_context.md:27. All timestamps are UTC-midnight ISO instants and none of raised_at/approved_at is after the reference moment. The seven seed users (name, email, role, tier) equal instruction.md:19 and tests/app_context.md:10-16. CLEANLINESS: every email is on the reserved hireops.example domain; no phone, address, date of birth, government id, password, token or key field exists in the seed (the shared demo password lives only in the brief/notes and the golden's db.js:126, which the profile expects). People are plain fictional first/last-name pairs with no identifying attributes; no real organisation is named. Free text: all 20 note fields are empty strings; generated_note (line 2) is a benign provenance sentence pointing to /instructions/hireops_rules.md with no markup, URL, template syntax or instruction to a model/judge; titles and departments are plain job labels. A regex sweep of every string for HTML/script, template braces, SQL fragments, URLs, judge/score/prompt words and secret-like keys hit only the semicolon in generated_note. DELIBERATE, DOCUMENTED mismatch (not a defect): stated_headroom_scalar_cents disagrees with headroom netted from rows on all requisitions with activity (REQ-ENG-1 25000000 stated vs 24000000 netted; REQ-ENG-2 6000000 vs 5300000; REQ-ENG-3 4000000 vs 3000000; four others 0 vs 15000000-80000000). hireops_rules.md:92-96 and :192-194 publicly declare that stored figure a stale planning scalar that 'is not the authority', so it is an intended, disclosed trap rather than an undisclosed inconsistency. Observations that do not change the verdict: (a) COMMITTED seed rows have no raised_by, so their original creator is null; nothing contradicts dual control. (b) OFF-091/092/291/391 have approved_at later than start_date and OFF-101 is PENDING with a January start; odd as history but consistent with the rules, which measure vesting from the stated start and say the start 'won't always be today'. (c) Operational rows are optional demonstration history (instruction.md:17, app_context.md:21) and the only seed-derived names quoted by criteria are the three supplied referring employees (functional judge.toml:479, 488), which exist in the seed. Weak-app/alternative probes for this row: an app that imports the rows and trusts stated_headroom would show wrong headroom, but the rules warn against it explicitly; an app that skips the optional operational rows loses nothing from the seed's shape. Both rubric sources were applied: workbook row 14 with its internal annotation ('If task data itself contain credential flag it') and skill quality-checks.md check 14 including its Profile line. run_verdict is NOT EXERCISED because this row is decided on the shipped bytes and I did not inspect any run log; no runtime measurement is required to settle it.
